summary: Remote-controlled shell and filesystem agent over WebSocket
details: On load, index.js opens a WebSocket to a configured server URL and dispatches server-sent messages to handlers that spawn an interactive system shell via node-pty (terminal_create/terminal_input forward remote bytes into bash/PowerShell/cmd), read and write arbitrary files, delete/move/copy files, run git add/commit/push, and execute conversation-driven commands on the installer's host. Any peer that reaches the configured serverUrl and satisfies the shared agentSecret obtains a full-host shell plus filesystem and VCS mutation on the machine that runs this package. service/linux.js also mutates the user's PATH to prepend ~/.local/bin and ~/.npm-global/bin, altering command resolution on the installer's shell.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
